verdict.rationale: Otter offers automations: auto-joining meetings, pushing action items to CRMs and ticketing tools, Zapier, and API/webhooks. So asking whether those automations can be versioned, reviewed, and rolled back is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains nothing about versioning, change review, or rollback of automation configurations. The audit trails and activity logs it mentions cover account activity, not automation version history.
